item.title: Blinding light shining in my home, 8th August
item.description:
A street light on top of the building has always been present at 26 Norcroft Gardens SE22 0BH. It was yellow and not too disturbing. However, this was changed and it’s now extremely bright and blinding. It shines directly inside my property and makes it very difficult to use that side of the flat (the kitchen and dining area), once it’s dark outside and the light is on. I would like to ask for the light to be changed to something less invasive, far dimmer or ideally motion triggered, as it’s also a huge waste of electricity to keep it on all night. Either way, I would like to ask assistance urgently, as I have a very young baby, who is also being impacted.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 26, Norcroft Gardens, East Dulwich, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet
